label: VERIFIED
scope: Read-only 25-client/8-round load against an exclusive local synthetic NODE_ENV=test store; real SQLite, no remote database or production hosting.

application_runtime.scope: Copied src, views, public excluding uploads, generated and package.json

result.latencyDefinition: nearest-rank percentiles from request start through complete response-body consumption; failed-body requests have no latency sample

limitations: One local synthetic run only; no production, remote-DB, physical-device, provider or field-CWV claim.
The workload makes read-only storefront requests without retaining customer session cookies; it is not an authenticated checkout/contention workload.
Response-body timing is included. HTTP429, server and network errors are separate failed counters, not treated as successful requests.
